title: Teams by region, poured into jars
label: Four glass jars stand side by side, one per region: North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific and Latin America. A stream of grains pours into each jar from above, every grain four teams, and the jars fill to different levels against a shared scale marked every 2,000 teams. Under each jar its count lands as the last grain does: 8,240, 6,560, 4,480 and 2,560. Beside the jars, the total read from all four, 21,840 teams, and a quote from Marisol Okafor, Head of Operations at Fernbank Freight: we switched in a week and haven't looked at another tool since. Then the jar floors open, the grains fall through, and the pour begins again.
